headline: Retail sales close the third quarter lower: fell 0.3% in September
summary: Mexican retail sales fell 0.3% in September, closing the third quarter lower, as consumers remain cautious and monthly declines appeared in three of the last four months.
why: Retail sales track consumer spending, which accounts for a large share of Mexico's GDP, so weakness signals pressure on domestic demand.
original_headline: Ventas minoristas cierran el tercer trimestre a la baja: cayeron 0.3% en septiembre
